name: MitID
description: MitID's own colours (its blue, white, navy and greys), small corners, a plain header and outlined cards; its ready and PIN screens in its blue; close, help, menu and next icons, menu rows with their lines, info boxes as notes, the approve card; every screen secure; codes as masked dots; the approve slider as a slide (touch); On the phone where it scans a passport or asks for a fingerprint.
